title: Getting to the Coast
transcript:
Woman: So for the trip to the coast, should we drive or take the train?
Man: Driving's cheaper if we split gas. But parking near the beach is a nightmare in summer.
Woman: True. And the train drops us right in town.
Man: It's two hours, though, compared to ninety minutes by car.
Woman: Yeah, but on the train I can actually sleep. You know I'd be the one driving.
Man: Fair point. Train it is. I'll look up tickets tonight before they sell out.

questions.stem: Why does the man mention parking near the beach?
options: To suggest they leave very early
To point out a drawback of driving
To complain about the cost of the train
questions.explanation: After noting driving is cheaper, he says parking is "a nightmare," a disadvantage of going by car.

questions.stem: What will the man do tonight?
questions.explanation: He says, "I'll look up tickets tonight before they sell out."
